Job Title: RPA Developer 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: Continental US 
 
* * * 
 
 
 
 The Opportunity: 
 
 We are seeking a RPA (Robotic Process Automation) Developer to support the Joint Transportation Management System (JTMS) program. The ideal candidate will work with automation technologies to streamline transportation and logistics processes, reduce manual tasks, and improve operational efficiency. This position offers an excellent opportunity for a developing professional to gain hands-on experience with enterprise automation solutions in support of critical defense operations. 

 The JTMS RPA Developer will work as part of a dynamic team responsible for designing, developing, testing, and deploying software robots that automate repetitive business processes within transportation management and logistics operations. This role involves working with leading RPA platforms to create intelligent automation solutions that enhance productivity and accuracy while reducing operational costs. 

 Responsibilities: 

 Design, develop, and deploy RPA bots using industry-standard platforms (e.g., UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism, or Power Automate) 
 Analyze business processes to identify automation opportunities within JTMS workflows 
 Create process definition documents (PDDs) and solution design documents (SDDs) 
 Develop and maintain automation scripts and workflows using RPA best practices 
 Perform unit testing, debugging, and troubleshooting of RPA solutions 
 Monitor bot performance and implement improvements to ensure reliability and efficiency 
 Collaborate with business analysts, system administrators, and stakeholders to gather requirements 
 Document automation processes, technical specifications, and user guides 
 Assist in the maintenance and enhancement of existing automation solutions 
 Participate in code reviews and follow established development standards 
 Support the deployment of bots to production environments 
 Provide basic support and troubleshooting for deployed automation solutions 


 Qualifications: 

 Required:  

 Must be US Citizen 
 Must have active Secret clearance 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field 
 1-2 years of experience with RPA development or related automation technologies 
 Basic programming knowledge (Python, C#, VB.NET, or Java) 
 Understanding of RPA lifecycle and best practices 
 Familiarity with process analysis and workflow design 
 Knowledge of basic database concepts and SQL queries 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 
 Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality 
 Ability to work effectively in a team environment 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills 


 Desired: 

 Experience with UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism, or Microsoft Power Automate 
 RPA certification (UiPath Certified Professional, Automation Anywhere Certified Advanced RPA Professional, etc.) 
 Familiarity with Agile SAFe methodologies 
 Experience with SAP and agility layer (ie, Mendix) 
 Knowledge of API integration and web services 
 Experience with OCR (Optical Character Recognition) and document processing 
 Understanding of transportation or logistics business processes 
 Experience with version control systems (Git, SVN) 
 Knowledge of AI/ML concepts and Intelligent Automation 
 Familiarity with .NET framework or Python scripting 


 
 
 
 
- 
 

 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$53,100-$106,300 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
